frame_order_diagnosis.rule: action_timeline must be nondecreasing by frame; this is a real semantic contract, not serialization preference.

implementation.behavior: validate_operational_plan_output walks actions in list order and rejects any frame below previous_frame; because a failed comparison does not advance previous_frame, the out-of-order condition also reports the following 2147-frame action.

frame_order_diagnosis.diagnosis: The candidate left the timeline unsorted. The delayed 2462 action remained before Steward@2131 and Ansel@2147 in list order.

static_gate_behavior.condition: frame < previous_ready OR available_sp + epsilon < required_sp -> SP_NOT_READY
static_gate_behavior.field_semantics: available_sp_model is cumulative time-SP since deploy and does NOT subtract a prior activation; it is not actual current SP.
static_gate_behavior.reason_label_limitation: SP_NOT_READY conflates two refusal branches: per-operator skill cooldown/not-yet-ready and insufficient accumulated SP.

runtime_behavior.timeline_execution_sort: The runtime sorts actions by time; stable normalization does not alter execution when there are no same-frame actions.

audit_calculation.units: frames for scheduled actions; SP and seconds for recovery; 30 FPS fixed
audit_calculation.interpretation: 88.0667 > 40 does not mean readiness; 88.0667 is unspent cumulative SP since deploy. Actual post-activation SP at 3903 is only 28.0667.

readiness_boundary.difference_cause: The static next-ready model adds a full 40 seconds after skill end and ignores the 0.0333 residual SP left after activation.
readiness_boundary.fix_scope_decision: No gate relaxation and no battle-mechanics change; the one-frame static/runtime difference is documented, not used to force the candidate through.
readiness_boundary.error_semantics_correction: 3903 was refused primarily by the per-skill cooldown branch, with actual SP also insufficient. Reporting only '88.0667 available SP' without branch context is misleading.

coupled_schedule_assessment.melanha_retreat_or_redeploy: NONE in this parent; Steward retreat/redeploy does not reset Melanha SP. Melanha survival through the late skills is a runtime condition and remains UNKNOWN.

minimum_schedule_shift_preserving_relati.policy: Shift all seven Melanha ACTIVATE_SKILL actions by the authorized +360 frames; all non-Melanha actions remain unchanged.
minimum_schedule_shift_preserving_relati.static_interval_basis: Original successful intervals are 1801 frames; the paired +360 shift retains them and is later than the static cooldown boundary.
minimum_schedule_shift_preserving_relati.risk: This exceeds the original two-frame authorization, changes later artillery/support timing, and must not be tested without a new controlled candidate authorization.

coupled_schedule_assessment.static_minimum_alternative_boundary: A reset-chain minimum would use 4262/6062/7862/9662/11462/13262 after 2462, but it does not preserve the original relative intervals. It is listed only as a boundary and is not recommended as the tactical test.

scope_boundary.m70_status: M70 remains the eight-ID complete fixed-simulator WIN and was not rerun.

next_unauthorized_suggestion: If a new controlled experiment is authorized, preserve the relative Melanha skill intervals by shifting all seven skill frames +360 and stable-sort the resulting timeline; this remains a tactical hypothesis and does not assert roadblock4/#14 success or improved heal competition.
